description: A FREE INTERIOR STAIR (STAIRS; buildings.md B1 'Stair': 'Interior check, free stair, rise 107.09375: 14 risers of 7.649554, 13 treads'): one loft.stair 1.0.0 with no deck, Total rise 107.09375 in from Z 0, its top nosing centred on the origin, running +Y, Risers Closed (open risers above 30 in are refused, IRC R311.7.5.1), every other input default. model.json and members.json are pinned by packages/loft-plugins/tests/test_stair.py; services/geometry/tests/test_stair_b1.py checks them.
derivation: INDEPENDENT of the plugins: test_stair_b1.script() types the 46 solids; the STEP matches them solid for solid.

risers ceil(107.09375 / 7.75) = 14 of R = 7.649553571 (107.09375 / 14); 13 treads, 143 in of run. Closed, the top riser line is at u = -0.875, where the stringers' head is cut plumb (the header's face; no top riser board, the floor above is not modelled). Profile: (-0.875, 13R - 1), then each tooth to (142.125, R - 1), the foot (142.125, 0), (131.982408, 0), (-0.875, 92.390896): 1 376.795619 in^2. THROAT 11.25 - 11R / sqrt(R^2 + 121) = 4.969740 in: under DCA6's 5 in, so the stored stair warns stair_throat_thin (and stair_guard_required: its top tread is 99.44 in up).

surface_area, centroid, mass_g and center_of_mass are the script's solids summed (southern_pine_pt 582 kg/m^3). Topology from the script's B-rep; MESH counts recorded. Interference none: the treads, risers, stringers, rail and posts meet face to face.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set (geometry-gates skill). ~2.9e8 mm^3 over 46 bodies: the kernel differs from the script by +1.2e-7 mm^3 on the volume, 3.0e-8 mm^2 on the area, <= 1.1e-10 mm on the centroid and centre of mass and 5.8e-11 g on the mass. 1e-6 is 8x the volume's.
roundtrip_tolerance_rationale: KERNEL-LEVEL, the b2-roof goldens' class, measured 2026-10-29: OCCT's STEP writer rounds the irrational slope (R / 11, R = 107.09375 / 14) of the three 14-step stringers and the 175 in handrail. Round-trip drift: volume +5.15e-4 mm^3, area +3.7e-5 mm^2, centroid 5.8e-10 mm (plugin); the build123d twin drifts -1.20e-4 / -1.3e-5 through build123d's export_step, so it is OCCT's STEP, not Loft's export. 1e-3 is 1.9x the worst and the b2-roof goldens' bound; volume and area only.
